A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

QscR is a third quorum-sensing regulator in P. aerugionosa that is activated by the LasI-generated 4-hydroxy-3-oxodododecanoylhomoserine lactones and regulates a subset of LasR- and/or RhlR-controlled genes.
QscR is a third quorum-sensing regulator that is activated by 3-oxo-C(12)-homoserine lactone.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the P. aerugiosa quorum-sensing regulatory network has more than the expected three levels of regulation.
QscR is not an orphan regulator, and it plays a significant role in the regulation of P. aeruginasia gene expression.
QscR is a bona fide transcriptional activator and repressor.
